column1: # The sequoia grove's understory (Plants: biome vegetation, giant sequoia trees installs them): row a my picks, row b alternatives and the dogwood's log.

column3: sword_fern|tplant|Western sword fern: a clump of 6-8 long arching fronds rising from the bottom edge, each a narrow tapering spear of small paired saw-toothed leaflets, the outer fronds bending outward and down, about 26 px tall, glossy dark green (#2e5a2a #3f7034 #548a40 #6a9a4a)
column4: lupine|plant|Lupine: two or three tall dense spikes of small pea flowers, blue-purple (#5646ae #7464c8 #9c8ce2) with white tips on the upper petals, the spikes 14-18 px tall tapering to a point, rising from a low clump of palmate leaves, each a fan of 7 narrow green leaflets (#3e6a32 #5a8a44 #78a258), about 26 px tall in all
column5: leaves_dogwood|fleaves|Pacific dogwood foliage in flower: oval green leaves with curved veins (#3e6a2e #4a7a34 #6a9446 #8ab05a), and 4-5 large flowers scattered among them, each four broad rounded creamy-white bracts (#f2eedc, shaded #d6d0bc) round a small yellow-green button centre, 6-8 px across
column6: log_sequoia_mossy|log|The bark of a fallen giant sequoia: the SAME red-brown fibrous bark with deep vertical furrows as the attached sequoia bark (the last reference image: the same colours, ridge width and light), now with thick cushions of bright green moss (#3e6a26 #5a8a34 #8eb24c) over about a third of it, rounded clumps 4-9 px that follow the furrows and spread across the ridges, a few pale-green tufts

column3: log_dogwood|log|The bark of a Pacific dogwood, a small slender tree: thin dark grey-brown bark (#4a3e36 #5e5048 #7e6e62) broken into small squarish scaly plates 3-5 px with fine darker cracks between them, a few paler grey flecks
column4: log_dogwood_top|end|The cut end of a slender Pacific dogwood log: pale pinkish-cream wood (#d8b896 #e4c6a4 #ecd2b2) with fine growth rings as thin darker lines (#a8846a), a small darker centre, a 2 px rim of dark grey-brown scaly bark (#4e4038)
column5: sword_fern_b@-|tplant|Western sword fern: a dense upright clump of 9-11 stiff fronds fanning out from the bottom edge like a shuttlecock, each a narrow spear of small paired leaflets, tips pointed, about 28 px tall, dark green (#2e5a2a #3f7034 #548a40 #6a9a4a)
column6: lupine_b@-|plant|Lupine: one tall dense spike of small pea flowers, blue-purple shading to pale lilac at the top (#5646ae #7464c8 #9c8ce2 #c4b8f0), 18-20 px tall, and one shorter spike beside it, over a clump of palmate leaves, each a fan of 7 narrow leaflets (#3e6a32 #5a8a44 #78a258), about 28 px tall in all
